Government Eyes Tax Collection Targets Amid GST Reforms

The Indian government is optimistic about meeting its tax collection budget targets, driven by ongoing Goods and Services Tax (GST) reforms. These reforms, along with an expanded taxpayer base and the implementation of Business-to-Consumer (B2C) e-invoicing, are expected to strengthen compliance and boost collections across both direct and indirect taxes. The focus is on making GST a 'good and simple tax' through these measures.
